comments.headline: Exterior Lighting Standards Require Scope Clarification and Compatibility Details
comments.summary: Sheet 9 exterior lighting note lacks scope definition and does not address Compatibility Standards requirements triggered by proximity to adjacent SF-3 property. Revisions must clarify applicability and include required shielding and screening details.
comments.attn: Verify Compatibility Standards triggering condition (MF-2 zoning within 75 feet of SF-3 parcel 0406100210). Vehicle light screening finding based on single review run.

details.text: Exterior lighting note states 'All exterior lighting will be full cut-off and fully shielded' without specifying that requirements apply only to new or proposed lighting, not existing fixtures. Revise note to specify 'new or proposed exterior lighting.'

runComments.comment: The exterior lighting note on Sheet 9, Block 1 states 'All exterior lighting will be full cut-off and fully shielded in compliance with Subchapter E 2.5...' but does not specify that it applies only to new or proposed exterior lighting, not to existing fixtures. The note must clarify scope to avoid confusion with any existing site fixtures.

The exterior lighting note on Sheet 9 states 'All exterior lighting will be full cut-off and fully shielded in compliance with Subchapter E 2.5' but does not specify that this requirement applies only to new or proposed exterior lighting, not to existing fixtures. General Site Plan Notes for COA require explicit clarification that the standard applies to proposed work only.

Exterior lighting note does not specify that requirements apply only to new or proposed lighting. Note states 'All exterior lighting will be full cut-off and fully shielded' without limiting scope to new/proposed fixtures, which could be interpreted to require modification of existing lighting. Revise note to specify 'new or proposed exterior lighting.'

details.text: Note does not specify that requirements apply within the limits of construction or project-specific boundaries. Revise note to specify application 'within the limits of construction' or 'within project-specific boundaries.'

runComments.comment: The exterior lighting note on Sheet 9, Block 1 does not specify that the requirement applies within the limits of construction or project-specific boundaries. The note must include clarifying language such as 'within the limits of construction' or 'for all new exterior lighting within the project site' to establish clear scope.

The exterior lighting note on Sheet 9 does not specify that it applies within the limits of construction or project-specific boundaries. General Site Plan Notes for COA require the note to clarify the scope and location of applicability to distinguish proposed site improvements from existing conditions outside the project limits.

Exterior lighting note does not specify application within limits of construction or project-specific boundaries. Note applies 'All exterior lighting' site-wide without scope limitation. Revise note to specify application 'within the limits of construction' or 'within project-specific boundaries.'

details.text: Note addresses only generic site lighting standards and does not demonstrate that exterior lighting is hooded or shielded so light source is not visible from the property line or alleyway shared with adjacent SF-3 parcel. Compatibility Standards exhibit with specific shielding details at shared property line is required.

runComments.comment: Site is within 75 feet of an adjacent SF-3 triggering property (0406100210) and zoned MF-2 (less restrictive), triggering Compatibility Standards under LDC § 25-2-1063(A). The exterior lighting note on Sheet 9 references only Subchapter E 2.5 generic site lighting standards and does not demonstrate compliance with the specific requirement that exterior lighting must be hooded or shielded so the light source is not visible from the property line or alleyway shared with the triggering property. A Compatibility Standards exhibit demonstrating shielding at the shared property line is required.

details.text: Plans do not show screening details for vehicle lights from vehicles using or parked on site. Vehicles must be screened so not visible from the property line or alleyway shared with adjacent SF-3 property per LDC § 25-2-1063(E)(1). Provide vehicle light screening details at shared property line.

runComments.comment: Site is subject to Compatibility Standards (MF-2 zoning within 75 feet of adjacent SF-3 parcel). The exterior lighting note on Sheet 9 addresses general lighting shielding per Subchapter E 2.5 but does not specifically address vehicle light screening from parking lots/structures. Under LDC § 25-2-1063(E)(1), vehicle lights from vehicles using or parked on a parking lot or in a parking structure must be screened from the property line or alleyway shared with the triggering property. This requirement must be demonstrated on the site plan with specific shielding details or clarifying notes.

No demonstration of compliance with LDC § 25-2-1063(E)(1) requirement that vehicle lights from vehicles using or parked on site must be screened so as not to be visible from the property line or alleyway shared with the adjacent SF-3 triggering property. Plans do not show vehicle light screening details or Compatibility Standards exhibit addressing this requirement. Screening details at the shared property line must be provided.

comments.headline: Plan Documentation and Coordination Issues Require Resolution
comments.summary: Four documentation issues span multiple sheets: landscape and civil plan building footprint mismatch; incomplete detail references and missing document numbers; unverified zoning case conditions; and unresolved project area discrepancy. All must be corrected before approval.
comments.crossDep: Landscape architecture coordination required to resolve building footprint mismatch between Sheets 9 and 31.
comments.attn: All findings based on single review runs. Plan mismatch between landscape and civil sheets requires immediate coordination. Zoning case conditions and area discrepancy flagged as not-verifiable; clarification needed.

details.text: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) building footprints and layout cannot be verified to match civil site plan (Sheet 9). Vision analysis suggests spatial arrangement differs. Coordinate with landscape architect to confirm building footprints and site layout are identical.

runComments.comment: Landscape plan building footprints, layout, and building placement cannot be verified to match civil site plan. Vision analysis of Sheet 31 landscape plan suggests spatial arrangement of buildings may differ from Sheet 9 civil plan configuration. Coordinate with landscape architect to confirm building footprints and site layout are identical between plans.

details.text: Incomplete detail reference on Sheet 9 near Building 2 states 'Tree Well need to look up approp. detail' with no complete specification. Two sidewalk easement callouts on same sheet missing document numbers (Doc# blank). All references must be complete with detail sheet and number.

runComments.comment: Incomplete detail reference located on Sheet 9 states 'Tree Well need to look up approp. detail' with no complete detail specification provided. Additionally, two sidewalk easement callouts on the same sheet are missing document numbers (Doc# left blank). All detail references must be complete and clearly identify the applicable detail sheet and detail number.

details.text: Zoning Case No. C14-2011-0093 referenced on cover sheet, but specific conditions of approval from this case are not identified on site plan. Obtain conditions from zoning case records and verify compliance on plan.

runComments.comment: Zoning Case No. C14-2011-0093 is referenced on cover sheet, but the specific conditions of approval from this zoning case are not identified or demonstrated on the site plan. Conditions of approval, if any exist for this case, must be obtained from zoning case records and verified for compliance on the plan.

details.text: Cover sheet states Project Area 2.16 acres but Limits of Construction 2.26 acres (0.1-acre or ~4,356 sq ft discrepancy). Discrepancy not clarified regarding extended limits (right-of-way improvements, utility easements, etc.). Note explaining extent and purpose of improvements beyond legal property boundary required.

runComments.comment: The cover sheet states Project Area of 2.16 acres but Limits of Construction of 2.26 acres—a difference of 0.1 acres (approximately 4,356 sq ft). The discrepancy is shown numerically on the cover sheet but is not clarified in terms of what constitutes the extended limits (e.g., right-of-way improvements, public utility easements, etc.). A note explaining the extent and purpose of improvements beyond the legal property boundary is required.

comments.headline: Erosion Hazard Zone Analysis Required for West Bouldin Creek Watershed
comments.summary: Site location within West Bouldin Creek Watershed may trigger Erosion Hazard Zone requirements. However, EHZ boundary analysis and compliance demonstration are not provided. Geographic confirmation of distance to creek and applicable design details are required.
comments.crossDep: Watershed Protection and City Engineer; EHZ analysis may affect drainage design and grading plan if 100-foot proximity trigger is confirmed.
comments.attn: EHZ triggering criteria unclear. Geographic confirmation of distance from site to West Bouldin Creek centerline required to determine whether 100-foot proximity threshold applies. If triggered, DCM Appendix E Level 1 analysis and 20-foot minimum setback from creek may apply.

details.text: EHZ legend symbol defined on Sheet 3 but no EHZ boundary delineated on storm sewer plan (Sheet 12), drainage area map (Sheet 13), or referenced in Engineer's Summary Letter. Without geographic confirmation of distance to West Bouldin Creek centerline, cannot verify whether 100-foot proximity trigger applies or whether 20-foot minimum setback applies. DCM Appendix E Level 1 EHZ analysis must be submitted if criteria are met.

runComments.comment: Erosion Hazard Zone (EHZ) legend symbol is defined on Sheet 3 (Block 6), but no EHZ boundary is delineated on the storm sewer plan (Sheet 12), drainage area map (Sheet 13), or referenced in the Engineer's Summary Letter. The site is located within the West Bouldin Creek Watershed (64+ acre drainage area). Without geographic confirmation of distance to the creek centerline, it cannot be verified whether the 100-foot proximity trigger applies, nor can compliance with the 20-foot minimum setback requirement be assessed. EHZ analysis per DCM Appendix E Level 1 procedure must be submitted if triggering criteria are met.
